purpose: Meta independent recomputation of C1 ground truth and target selection with a separately written Python ast pass (not the runner's code).
script:
import ast, sys, json, hashlib, builtins, collections
from pathlib import Path
base = Path(sys.argv[1]) / "src/gaia_cli"
targets = ["spec_by_id", "computeTrustMagnitude", "suiteComponentIds", "rankWord", "embeddings_path"]
files = [p for p in base.rglob("*.py") if "data" not in p.relative_to(base).parts[:1]]
callers = collections.defaultdict(set); defs = collections.Counter()
callsites = collections.defaultdict(set)
class V(ast.NodeVisitor):
    def __init__(s, rel): s.rel, s.stack = rel, []
    def fn(s, n):
        defs[n.name] += 1; s.stack.append(n.name); s.generic_visit(n); s.stack.pop()
    visit_FunctionDef = visit_AsyncFunctionDef = fn
    def visit_Call(s, n):
        f = n.func; name = f.id if isinstance(f, ast.Name) else f.attr if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute) else None
        if name: callsites[name].add((s.rel, s.stack[-1] if s.stack else "<module>"))
        s.generic_visit(n)
for p in files:
    V(p.relative_to(base).as_posix()).visit(ast.parse(p.read_text(), str(p)))
out = {t: sorted(map(list, callsites[t])) for t in targets}
print(json.dumps({t: [len(v), v] for t, v in out.items()}, indent=0))
# independent selection-rule check
excl = set(dir(builtins))
import hashlib as h_, json as j_, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, time, datetime
for m in (h_, j_, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, time, datetime): excl |= set(dir(m))
rev = "d237c0839c9c9197fc861ecec839ed323a9748a4"
cand = [n for n, c in defs.items() if c == 1 and not n.startswith("_") and n not in excl
        and 3 <= len(callsites[n]) <= 15 and len({f for f, _ in callsites[n]}) >= 2]
cand.sort(key=lambda n: hashlib.sha256((n + rev).encode()).hexdigest())
print("selection first 5:", cand[:5], "pool", len(cand))
